item.title: Single-Family-Owned, 4,500-Mile 2005 Dodge Neon SRT-4 ACR Mopar Stage 3R at No Reserve
item.description: This 2005 Dodge Neon SRT-4 is one of 1,175 ACR models produced and its turbocharged 2.4-liter inline-four features the Mopar Stage 3R Turbo kit which included a larger turbocharger, a revised exhaust manifold, an upgraded PCM, a high-flow fuel system, high-flow MAP and TIP sensors, and an intercooler fluid mister system. item.title: 1957 Cushman Eagle w/Sidecar at No Reserve
item.description: This 1957 Cushman Eagle sidecar rig was refurbished under prior ownership and acquired by the current owner circa 2015, and thereafter placed on static display. Equipment includes a 318cc Husky four-stroke flathead single paired with a hand-shifted two-speed manual transmission. item.title: 4,700-Mile 1988 Ford Thunderbird Turbo Coupe
item.description: This 1988 Ford Thunderbird Turbo Coupe shows 4,700 miles and is powered by a turbocharged 2.3-liter inline-four linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a Traction-Lock differential. Repainted in Medium Red Metallic over Scarlet Red cloth upholstery, the car is equipped with four-wheel disc brakes, 16″ aluminum wheels, power windows, a power-adjustable driver seat, a cassette stereo, cruise control, and automatic climate control. item.description: This 2008 Lamborghini Murciélago LP640 roadster is finished in Bianco Isis over black and white leather and is powered by a 6.5-liter V12 linked with an E-gear six-speed automated transmission and a Viscous Traction all-wheel-drive system with a limited-slip rear differential. item.title: Ex–Peter Revson 1968 McLaren M6B at No Reserve
item.description: This McLaren M6B is one of two examples delivered new to Shelby Racing Company for use with backing from Ford in the 1968 Can-Am racing season, during which it was driven by Peter Revson. Powered by an aluminum-block Ford V8, chassis 50-12 claimed a victory in the 1968 Fuji Can-Am 200 at Fuji International Raceway with Revson at the wheel before being sold after Shelby’s withdrawal from Can-Am racing at the season’s end. item.description: This 1989 Chevrolet Corvette Challenge was delivered new to Tom Bell Chevrolet of Redlands, California, where it served as a backup vehicle before being piloted in 10 races of the SCCA Corvette Challenge division 1989 season by Stu Hayner, who won the championship the prior year. item.title: 13k-Mile 1989 Ferrari 328 GTS
item.description: This 1989 Ferrari 328 GTS spent over three decades in Florida before the current owner's acquisition on BaT in July 2025. Finished in Rosso Corsa over beige leather, the car is powered by a 3.2-liter V8 linked to a five-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 571-Mile Cobalt Blue Metallic 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach
item.description: This 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS has 571 miles following registration history in Hawaii and Illinois, and it was optioned with a paint-to-sample Cobalt Blue Metallic exterior finish in addition to the Weissach Package. item.title: 1956 Mercedes-Benz 300SL Gullwing
item.description: This 1956 Mercedes-Benz 300SL is one of 1,400 Gullwing coupes built during three years of production and is noted to have left the factory on September 24, 1956, for initial delivery in Los Angeles, California. Chassis 6500242 reportedly remained in the state under the care of three different owners through the selling dealer's purchase two years ago.
